system_and_unit: Synapsin-Cre Wwox neocortical L2/3 slices P13-P17; animal is the unit, slices nested; number of animals not fixed (dependencies in README section 6)
genotype_or_manipulation: S-KO, S-HT, Cre+ S-WT controls (Breton), never pooled
readouts: isolated NMDAR current (amplitude, decay, GluN2B sensitivity); sIPSC amplitude, frequency AND charge with physiological internal chloride; miniature IPSC amplitude and frequency in TTX (and paired-pulse ratio or failure rate of evoked IPSCs where possible) as locus readouts; Vm and Rin; XE991-sensitive current; AMPAR current; sag, rebound, XE991- and ZD7288-sensitive currents
prediction_fixed_before: KO sIPSC charge clearly below Cre+ WT; HT value unknown (the earlier 80 percent threshold is withdrawn); NMDAR and AMPAR currents measured not inferred
what_would_change: HT inhibition reduced like KO: inhibition loses KO-v-HT specificity; raised NMDAR/AMPAR current: excitatory-gain rival leads; sag/rebound/current differences: intrinsic rival lives
controls: same internal solution and temperature across genotypes; blind to genotype; recording order balanced

system_and_unit: same preparation, WT (Cre+) and HT; animal is the unit; sample size not fixed
genotype_or_manipulation: single manipulations: (i) gabazine titrated to the KO-measured IPSC charge fraction (shows sufficiency of disinhibition in a normal circuit only); (ii) bath K+ step (NOT Vm-matching; a failure does not refute the intrinsic rival); (iii) Mg2+ lowered only if E0 shows raised NMDAR current
agent_and_role: gabazine (T1), K+ (T1); d-AP5 as last step
readouts: burst incidence per arm (slices, with animals as units), d-APV sensitivity of any burst
prediction_fixed_before: no numeric ratio criterion (twice the fraction dropped as too weak); the informative read is whether the KO-measured excitatory change in a WT circuit needs the inhibitory loss
what_would_change: with E0, separates repair from counterbalance; (ii) equals (i) is not interpretable as intrinsic sufficiency because K+ does not reproduce Rin, sag or rebound
controls: TTX confirms activity-driven events; vehicle arm; the HT slices tested with and without (i)

system_and_unit: S-KO slices (bursting), one slice per animal per condition where possible
genotype_or_manipulation: single-mechanism corrections titrated to restore the control value of the targeted quantity: IPSC charge (H1 or A1), Vm (D1)
agent_and_role: clobazam with N-desmethylclobazam (graded, with measured IPSC charge); tiagabine; ezogabine with XE991 reversal; GluN2B NAM radiprodil; AMPAR antagonist comparator; Ih blocker; d-AP5 last
readouts: burst frequency, duration, amplitude; IPSC charge, Vm, NMDAR current at the concentration used (verified in the same slice)
prediction_fixed_before: no threshold fixed; restoration to control charge is not guaranteed (about 48 percent KO amplitude v potentiation of a few-fold at low GABA (Ralvenius 2016: Emax 100 to 317 percent at EC10 in rat HEK293 cells, the metabolite 143 to 253; Hammer 2015: 203 to 270 percent at EC20 in human oocytes; species, system and agonist level differ)), graded partial restoration with a graded effect is a partial-benefit result and no effect at sub-control restoration shows insufficiency at that degree; E2 alone cannot separate repair from counterbalance; WT matched-trigger effects reflect network state
what_would_change: if Vm restoration also stops bursts, intrinsic and inhibitory deficits are both sufficient-correctable (no single step); if no single arm works, interaction or secondary state
controls: suppression index (effect in WT matched-trigger slices); viability, AP height and washout as requirements; F-I curve and Rin measured and reported (an expected change under GABA-A potentiation or Kv7 opening is a mechanism marker, not an exclusion); evoked fEPSP slope; no layer-marker or persistence requirement

system_and_unit: S-KO and S-WT slices matched for animal weight, glycaemia (measured) and myelination state where available
prediction_fixed_before: burst incidence not explained by weight or glycaemia within genotype
what_would_change: R4 and R5 are not separable by E0 to E2; E3 records covariates only
controls: record age, weight and glucose per animal
